page.notes: Years in the right column, from top: 1555, 1556, 1557, 1558, 1559, 1560, 1561. Left-margin notes are set in a smaller roman type and are transcribed as foot notes. The reading of several surnames is uncertain (e.g. "Sasscher", "Wisfringe", "Iarges") and the rendering of the long s and the handwritten/ligature forms is approximate; no [?] markers were applied, so treat the names as needing verification against the scan. The 1560 entry's year and the first-column names are partly obscured by staining.
